footer.legal: This is an estimate, not 100% accurate. Not legal advice. Confirm with a lot survey and the City.
terms.intro: These terms are an agreement between you and MaxBLD ("we", "us"). They cover the MaxBLD website at maxbld.ca and the MaxBLD app for iOS and Android. By creating an account you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use MaxBLD.
terms.s1.basis: Reports are based on public City of Toronto data and our reading of it.
terms.s1.changes: Changes to the service. We may change, add or remove features.
terms.s1.lot_size: Lot size you enter. You can enter a lot size for a lot. This is shared with other users as a fact about the lot. Only enter a size you believe is correct. See the Privacy Policy for what happens to it if you delete your account.
terms.s1.not: What MaxBLD is not. A report is an estimate. It is not a City zoning review, legal advice or a permit decision. This means:
terms.s1.not.1: A report is our reading. The City may read the by-law differently.
terms.s1.not.2: Public City data can be out of date, incomplete or wrong. We do not control it.
terms.s1.not.3: Cost estimates are estimates. Real costs can be higher or lower.
terms.s1.not.4: A report does not replace a lawyer, architect, designer, planner, or the City's own zoning review or permit process.
terms.s1.not.5: Do not make a decision to buy, design or apply based on a report alone. Confirm with a lot survey and the City first.
terms.s1.what: What MaxBLD does. MaxBLD gives you a report about a lot in Toronto. A report shows what Toronto zoning by-laws appear to allow on that lot, including:
terms.s1.what.1: the by-law specifications that appear to apply;
terms.s2.1: You can sign up with your email, or sign in with Google or Apple.
terms.s2.2: We ask for your name and email.
terms.s2.3: Keep your sign-in details private. You are responsible for activity on your account.
terms.s2.5: Deleting your account. You can delete your account from Account. Billing stops at the end of your current billing period. Your account is removed after 30 days. If you sign back in within those 30 days, your account is kept. See the Privacy Policy for details.
terms.s3.manage: Where to manage your plan. You start, change or cancel your plan on the web at maxbld.ca, through Stripe's customer portal. You cannot buy or change a plan inside the iOS or Android app.
terms.s3.payments: Payments. Payments are handled by Stripe. We do not store your card number.
terms.s3.plans: Plans. MaxBLD has a free trial and three plans: Basic, Pro and Enterprise. Basic and Pro are monthly plans, each with a set number of reports each month. Enterprise is priced by quote; contact us through Help & Support. The price and the number of reports of each plan are shown before you buy. Prices are in Canadian dollars, plus HST.
terms.s3.reports.1: Your plan includes a set number of reports each month.
terms.s3.reports.2: Your count resets on your billing date. Unused reports do not carry over.
terms.s3.reports.3: Opening a lot you have already used a report on in the same billing period does not count again.
terms.s3.reports.4: We may change the number of reports in a plan.
terms.s3.trial.1: New accounts get a free trial. The trial is for accounts that never had a MaxBLD plan. Its length and the number of reports it includes are shown before you start.
terms.s3.trial.2: You must add a card to start the trial.
terms.s3.trial.3: If you do not cancel before the trial ends, the trial continues on the Basic plan: your card is charged the Basic price, then every month on your billing date.
terms.s3.trial.4: You can cancel any time before the trial ends and you will not be charged.
terms.s4.1: You can cancel your plan any time on the web through Stripe's customer portal.
terms.s4.2: If you cancel during the free trial, you are not charged.
terms.s4.3: If you cancel after the trial, your plan stays active until the end of the period you have paid for. You are not charged again.
terms.s4.4: Nothing in these terms takes away any right you have under Ontario consumer protection law, including any right to cancel an online agreement.
terms.s5.1: copy, scrape, resell or republish reports or data from MaxBLD in bulk;
terms.s5.2: share your account with others to get around the monthly report count;
terms.s5.3: try to break, overload or get around the security of MaxBLD;
terms.s5.4: enter false information, including a lot size you know is wrong;
terms.s5.suspend: We may suspend or close an account that breaks these rules.
terms.s6.1: Questions about these terms: contact us through Help & Support.
